speaker: john_heminges
text: Nine, and not eleven. You are for Blackfriars, then the Bell.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Field, then Hobbins. I will be back for two.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Two is yours if you are here. We are not holding an entrance for a book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will be here. Egeon does not need a longer morning than this.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then go. The rest of them can stumble without you.
